problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.statement: Given a string s containing only the characters ( ) [ ] { }, return true if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order, and every closing bracket has a matching opening bracket.

events.text: I need to check that every bracket in a string is closed by the same type, in the right order. What approaches are there?
You can repeatedly delete matched pairs like "()" until nothing changes, or use a stack in one pass.
I'll go with the faster one. Any pitfalls in how I update state?
Update the result after adjusting your pointers or map, not before.
What edge cases should I check now that my code passes the examples?
Try the smallest inputs, duplicates, and the boundaries described in the constraints.
